analysis.summary: Crestchem Limited reported an increase in total income to Rs. 25.52 Cr and net profit to Rs. 2.73 Cr for the financial year ended March 31, 2025, compared to the previous year. The Board of Directors recommended a final dividend of 10% (Rs. 1/- per equity share) for the year 2024-25.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is actively planning to expand and invest in new or start-up businesses in limited liability partnership (LLP) firms within specialty chemicals.
capex_expansion.quote: As was reported in previous financial year’s Annual Report the Company is now actively planning to expand and invest in new/start up business in limited liability partnership (LLP) firms, within our Speciallity Chemicals and related fields of operations.

capex_expansion.claim: A requisite pilot plant facility for such products is likely to be established by the company at LLP firms in due course.
capex_expansion.quote: Accordingly, requisite pilot plant facility, for such products, is likely to be established by our company at such LLP firms, in due Course.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning to invest in new or startup businesses or limited liability partnership firms within its overall chemical and related field of operations.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company is planning to invest in new/start up business- limited liability partnership firm(s), within our overall chemical and related field of operations.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has assigned project work to an entity of CSIR and is hopeful for a pilot plant during FY 2025-26 or thereafter.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year under review company has assigned the Project Work to one of the entites of CSIR. Company is hopeful for pilot plant during FY 2025-26 or thereafter.

margins_costs.claim: Price volatilities continued during the year under review.
margins_costs.quote: The Price volatilities is remains continued during the year under review.

capital_allocation.claim: The board of directors recommended a final dividend of 10% (Rs. 1/- per share) for the financial year 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: To declare a final dividend of Rs 1/- (10%) per equity share of Rs. 10/- each, for the financial year ended March 31,2025

capital_allocation.claim: The company is debt free and has no borrowings from any bank or institution.
capital_allocation.quote: The company has no borrowings from any Bank or any Institution. There are no outstanding interest payments. Our company is debt free.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a 5% maiden dividend for the financial year 2023-24.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors recommended 5% Maiden Dividend for the year 2023-24.

risks_headwinds.claim: Disturbances from international events like Covid-19 and the Ukraine war affected the company and supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: Disturbances due to International event like Covid-19, Ukraine war etc. are being faced by the company.

risks_headwinds.claim: Prolonged ill effects and disturbances in the supply chain continued till the date of the report.
risks_headwinds.quote: The prolonged ill effects including disturbances in the supply chain and such other disturbances continued till the date of this report.

risks_headwinds.claim: Price volatilities continued during the year under review.
risks_headwinds.quote: The Price volatilities is remains continued during the year under review.

risks_headwinds.claim: Disturbances due to international events such as Covid-19 and the Ukraine war continue to be faced by the company, including prolonged ill effects on the supply chain.
risks_headwinds.quote: Disturbances due to International event like Covid-19, Ukraine war etc. are being faced by the company. The prolonged ill effects including disturbances in the supply chain and such other disturbances continued till the date of this report.

risks_headwinds.claim: Ongoing uncertain macroeconomic situations create concerns, prompting management to maintain a keen vigil and quickly adapt remedial actions.
risks_headwinds.quote: Concerns due to the ongoing uncertain macro economic situation, remains, but Company, is maintaining keen vigil over the ever-changing situation and quickly adapt remedial actions.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to establish a requisite pilot plant facility at LLP firms in due course.
management_commitments.quote: Accordingly, requisite pilot plant facility, for such products, is likely to be established by our company at such LLP firms, in due Course.

management_commitments.claim: The company is hopeful for a pilot plant during FY 2025-26 or thereafter.
management_commitments.quote: Company is hopeful for pilot plant during FY 2025-26 or thereafter.
